description: Identifies employees with high attrition risk from company data, requires human approval, and sends notifications to department managers

steps.name: Retrieve High Attrition Employees
steps.description: Queries the dataset through the Space and filters for Attrition Flag = High

steps.name: Analyze Attrition Risk Factors
steps.description: Processes the filtered results (~300 employees) and identifies patterns

configuration.prompt: Analyze the high-attrition employees and group them by department. For each department, identify the top 3 contributing risk factors based on engagement scores, satisfaction scores, and work-life balance. Summarize findings in a concise report for manager review.

steps.name: Human Approval Process
steps.description: Pauses execution until a designated approver reviews and approves the notification content

configuration.approvalMessage: Please review the attrition risk report before it is sent to department managers. Verify that no sensitive information is included in the notification.

steps.name: Manager Notification
steps.description: After approval, sends department-specific alerts to the dept-managers group

configuration.bodyTemplate: High attrition risk employees identified in your department. Please review the attached summary and take appropriate retention actions.

securityNotes: Flow connects to RLS-protected manager dataset (not full dataset)
Sensitive columns (salary, bonus) are not present in the connected dataset
Human approval gate prevents automated outbound communication without review
Each manager receives only their own department's data due to RLS
External credentials (if any) should be stored in AWS Secrets Manager
